title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Did you do something nice for your wife since it’s Mother’s Day and you’re home for once?

We had breakfast, and Dinner together and my mother and Father came over for dinner. I can’t wait until we start playing again and I get hammered by you, Hahaha. Honestly and I am sure you agree. This is weird times and I can’t wait to some resemblance of normalcy. can’t come to soon. I hope you are doing OK. I know you guys are getting furloughed off and on. If you need anything, you can count on me.
Appreciate that. I am doing fine, still employed, better than most. Stay safe. I will try you tomorrow, no real questions, but I have a couple ideas for you I have been thinking about
